extras: Analysis sends note content to external services; API keys are stored in Obsidian Secrets.
problem: Generating tags note by note can lead to overlapping labels and a bloated tag vocabulary, and traditional LLM taggers can be slow and expensive.

requires.name: TypeSafe, OpenRouter, OpenAI, or Gemini API key

summary: AI-powered tool that matches and applies relevant tags to notes using decision models, allowing users to leverage existing vault tags or custom sets.
